steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain. Tip into a baking dish.
Stir {{ing:passata}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:dried-oregano}} through the pasta.
Tear over {{ing:mozzarella}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain. Tip into a baking dish.
Fry {{ing:sausage-pork}} meat out of its skins with {{ing:fennel-seeds}} 8 minutes. Stir through the pasta with {{ing:passata}}.
Scatter {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain. Tip into a baking dish.
Stir drained {{ing:tuna-tinned-in-spring-water}}, {{ing:sweetcorn-tinned}} and {{ing:passata}} through the pasta.
Scatter {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain. Tip into a baking dish.
Shred {{ing:chicken-breast-roast}}. Stir through the pasta with {{ing:pesto}} and {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.
Tear over {{ing:mozzarella}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain. Tip into a baking dish.
Stir chopped {{ing:courgette}}, {{ing:pepper-bell}}, {{ing:red-onion}} and {{ing:passata}} through the pasta.
Crumble over {{ing:feta}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain. Tip into a baking dish.
Add {{ing:broccoli-head}} florets to the pasta water for the last 3 minutes. Whisk {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:butter-unsalted}} until thick.
Stir in most of {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}; scatter the rest.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain. Tip into a baking dish.
Mix {{ing:beef-mince-5-fat}} and {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}. Roll 16 balls. Nestle in the pasta with {{ing:passata}}.
Tear over {{ing:mozzarella}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain. Tip into a baking dish.
Stir wilted {{ing:spinach}}, {{ing:ricotta}}, {{ing:nutmeg}} and {{ing:passata}} through the pasta.
Grate over {{ing:parmesan}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.

Heat the oven to 180C.

Bake 75 minutes, until tender and golden on top.
Heat the oven to 180C.

Heat the oven to 180C.
Slice {{ing:fennel-bulb}} thinly.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C.
Slice {{ing:butternut-squash}} thinly.
Layer in a buttered baking dish.
Pour over or scatter {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:fresh-sage}} and {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Bake 50 minutes, until tender and golden on top.
Heat the oven to 180C.

Pour over or scatter {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Bake 60 minutes, until tender and golden on top.
Heat the oven to 180C.
Slice {{ing:cauliflower-head}} and {{ing:broccoli-head}} thinly.

Pour over or scatter {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until tender and golden on top.

Layer in a buttered baking dish.
Pour over or scatter {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-flakes}}.
Bake 50 minutes, until tender and golden on top.
Heat the oven to 180C.
Slice {{ing:tomato-medium}} thinly.
Layer in a buttered baking dish.
Pour over or scatter {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until tender and golden on top.
Toss diced {{ing:beef-braising}} in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Brown in a casserole with chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}.
Add {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} and {{ing:stock-cube}} in 500 ml water. Cover. Cook in the oven at 160C for 2 hours.
Cool a little. Tip into a pie dish. Turn the oven up to 200C.
Top with {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Brown {{ing:beef-mince-5-fat}} with chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} 10 minutes.
Add {tomato-purée} and {{ing:stock-cube}} in 300 ml water. Simmer 20 minutes.
Boil peeled {{ing:potato-large}} 20 minutes. Mash with {{ing:butter-unsalted}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Heat the oven to 200C. Tip the mince into a dish. Top with the mash.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden.
Boil peeled {{ing:potato-large}} 20 minutes. Mash.
Melt {{ing:butter-unsalted}}. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add {{ing:milk-whole}} slowly until thick.
Add {{ing:haddock-smoked}} in chunks, {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and {{ing:peas-frozen}}. Tip into a dish.
Heat the oven to 200C. Top with the mash.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
Heat the oven to 200C. Fry sliced {{ing:leek}} and diced {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} in {{ing:butter-unsalted}} 10 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Add {{ing:stock-chicken}} until thick.
Stir in {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and {{ing:fresh-tarragon}}. Tip into a pie dish.
Top with {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden.
Heat the oven to 200C. Boil diced {{ing:potato-medium}} 10 minutes. Drain.
Fry sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:butter-unsalted}} 10 minutes.
Mix with the potato and grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Line a pie dish with two thirds of {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Fill. Cover with the rest.
Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Bake 40 minutes, until golden.
Heat the oven to 200C. Dice {{ing:carrot-medium}}, {{ing:parsnip}} and {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} 10 minutes.
Add drained {{ing:lentils-tinned}}, {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Tip into a pie dish. Top with {{ing:puff-pastry}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden.
Brown {{ing:lamb-mince}} with chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} 10 minutes.
Add {tomato-purée}, {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} and {{ing:stock-cube}} in 300 ml water. Simmer 20 minutes.
Boil peeled {{ing:potato-large}} 20 minutes. Mash with {{ing:butter-unsalted}}.
Heat the oven to 200C. Tip the lamb into a dish. Top with mash.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden.
Dice {{ing:pork-shoulder}}. Brown with chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}. Add {{ing:cider-dry}}. Simmer 45 minutes, until tender.
Stir in chopped {{ing:apple-medium}} and {{ing:fresh-sage}}. Cool.
Heat the oven to 200C. Line a pie dish with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Fill. Cover.
Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Bake 40 minutes, until golden.
